**RidgeKey 1.0** - the first production release. Touch ID-style fingerprint login for macOS on
laptops whose reader macOS doesn't support, for match-on-chip readers, built on libfprint.

### What you get
- 🔓 **Lock screen** - unlock with a touch, display on or asleep
- 🛡️ **Admin dialogs** - System Settings locks, installers and "wants to make changes" prompts accept an administrator's fingerprint; one touch per action
- ⌨️ **sudo** - approve in Terminal; "Touch the fingerprint sensor" tells you when
- 👆 **Finger actions** - tap, double/triple tap or hold a finger to lock the screen or run a Shortcut
- 🗂️ **RidgeKey app** - enroll with live progress, manage fingers, switch features on and off; **Help** opens the [documentation](https://labrouss.github.io/RidgeKey/)

Your password always keeps working: a wrong finger, a timeout or **Use Password** brings back the normal macOS prompt.

### Safe by design
- Never erases the reader's whole storage - Windows Hello and BIOS fingerprints on the same sensor are left alone. Every driver's erase-all command is removed and CI checks it.
- Changing fingerprints or finger actions needs an enrolled finger or your password.
- Only the installed RidgeKey app and `ridgekeyctl` may manage prints; the stored password stays in the System keychain, readable only by root.

### Install
1. Download **`RidgeKey-1.0.0.pkg`** below and open it.
2. It isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID: the first time, right-click → **Open** (or System Settings → Privacy & Security → **Open Anyway**).
3. Open **RidgeKey** → **Fingerprints** → **Enroll…**

**Upgrading from 0.x:** install over it - fingers, the stored password and settings are kept.
Terminal install: the `.tar.gz` bundle, then `sudo ./install.sh`.

### Readers
| | |
|---|---|
| Tested | Synaptics **06cb:00f0** - HP EliteBook 840 G8, macOS Tahoe |
| Reported working | Synaptics **06cb:00bd** |
| Included, untested | Goodix, Elan, FPC, Egis, FocalTech and Realtek match-on-chip readers (`supported-devices.txt` lists the USB IDs) |

Tried another reader? [Tell us](https://github.com/labrouss/RidgeKey/issues/new) - working or not.

### Requirements and limits
- Intel Macs / Hackintoshes, macOS 13 or later (tested on Tahoe)
- The lock screen needs Accessibility permission for **RidgeKey Agent** (once; kept across upgrades)
- Not notarized by Apple (see Install)

|---|---|
| `RidgeKey-1.0.0.pkg` | double-click installer |

Full history: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/labrouss/RidgeKey/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). libfprint, GLib, gusb and libusb are LGPL-2.1-or-later; our patches are in `patches/`.
